claimed_purpose.text: claude-mem (thedotmack/claude-mem): Claude Code / IDE hook plugin that compresses sessions into SQLite-backed observations and injects retrieved context across turns—developer-session memory, not a consumer companion product.

mechanisms.text: Store: local SQLite (observations, summaries, sessions, FTS5); curated observation records with types/metadata—not a full transcript replay; optional cloud sync / hosted MCP (cmem.ai Pro).

Write: 5-stage hook lifecycle captures tool/user output → worker extracts observations (provider-configurable); private tags gate capture; folder CLAUDE.md sidecar context; issues #2793/#3848 flag unbounded prompt storage and cost.
Retrieve: MCP search tools (3-layer progressive disclosure); context generator / ObservationCompiler injects recent observations; file-read gate substitutes observation history for re-reads.
Forget: retention/eviction via quota guards (#4068) and RateLimitStore paths; manual recovery for stuck observations; pending_messages wiring contested in issues—no companion-style soft forget API.
Isolation: per-project / memory_session_id scoping (#3608 plan); observer subprocess isolation (#3607); fail-open hook wrapper (#3605) vs fail-loud thresholds (#3834) trade continuity for safety.
